chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, from his father, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with a virgin slave-girl without fully opening her. Is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: When the circumcised part meets the circumcised part, then ghusl has become obligatory, whether she is a virgin or non-virgin.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الْخِتَانَ: the circumcised part; a legal expression for genital contact
key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: ritual bath made obligatory after janabah
key_terms.يُفْضِي: to fully open or penetrate in this context

ai.seo_question: When does ghusl become obligatory after intercourse according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling that ghusl becomes obligatory upon the occurrence of genital contact signified by the meeting of the two circumcised parts. The ruling applies equally to a virgin and a non-virgin, establishing the legal criterion for janabah in this case.
